title: StoryShelf client config
description: .storybook/storyshelf.json — per-Storybook client configuration for the storyshelf CLI. Unknown keys are ignored.

$schema.description: JSON Schema location for editor support. Stamped automatically by `storyshelf init`.

buildCommand.description: Custom build command. Mutually exclusive with buildScriptName.

buildScriptName.description: Package script to build Storybook (default build-storybook). Mutually exclusive with buildCommand.

skip.description: Glob to skip upload for matching branches.

untraced.description: Glob patterns excluded from affected tracing (union with --untraced).

not.description: buildCommand and buildScriptName are mutually exclusive.
